attachments.insertion_landmark: 1st metatarsal base, medial cuneiform (via a long plantar course)

actions: everts the ankle, assists plantarflexion, supports the transverse (metatarsal) arch

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Its tendon crosses the entire plantar surface of the foot from lateral to medial (via the cuboid tunnel), the longest tendon course of any lower-limb muscle relative to its origin.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
